'''Horn Ambigene''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as a [[General/Legends|general]] within the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the conclusion of the conflict, Ambigene became the leader of the [[Bryx Freedom Fighters]], a force of [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdout]] of the former Confederacy that operated in the [[Bryx sector/Legends|Bryx sector]]. Following the [[Declaration of Rebellion/Legends|Declaration of Rebellion]], Ambigene publicly renounced his Separatist past, and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he brought the Freedom Fighters into the fold of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], within which they became known as the [[Bryx Sector Force]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
